Did you know that 4/5 customers can find health coverage for less than $10 per month through the Health Insurance Marketplace?

If you are looking to switch your health insurance, find a less expensive option, or compare plans, please visit ➡️ https://t.co/d8xaE1gwV9 https://t.co/7UaokV6UkE

.@BostonChildrens provides critical care to thousands of patients across New Hampshire. Great conversation yesterday about working together to lower costs and ensure every child in the Granite State gets the health care they need. https://t.co/f9YK5ioKz6

Thrilled to have Andrea Packard, a dental assistant serving patients in the North Country and a student at @NHTI, as my guest for tonight's Joint Session of Congress. 

📺 A message before tonight's address: https://t.co/MNcQfFxxe6

Today, I spent time with an extraordinary community of @alzheimersmanh advocates from across New Hampshire. I heard about the heartbreak and challenges that tens of thousands of patients, caregivers, and families battling Alzheimer’s and dementia face every single day. 

There was not a dry eye in the room.

I am bringing your voices to Congress in our fight to protect Medicaid and Medicare, to advance mission-critical research and clinical trials that will help us end Alzheimer's as we know it, and to ensure that the tens of thousands of caregivers across New Hampshire get the credit and support they need and deserve.

I learned to swim at the old YMCA right on Prospect Street in Nashua. I know firsthand the role the @NMYMCA and YMCAs across New Hampshire play in our communities.

Whether it’s child care, health and wellness support, or sports programs for young Granite Staters, I am proud to support the YMCA’s critical mission here in New Hampshire. I will keep fighting to defend every federal dollar that makes their programming possible.

Our rural hospitals are already operating on the slimmest of margins – and if Republicans’ proposed cuts to Medicaid go into effect, many of them will face a true crisis.

Protecting Medicaid is a matter of life and death for thousands of people across New Hampshire, and I am fighting with absolutely everything I’ve got to defend this essential program.

Important discussion this morning in Lebanon with partners from the NH Department of Health and Human Services and providers from Dartmouth Health who are on the frontlines of delivering life-saving healthcare, including maternal healthcare and substance use treatment. I heard in detail about the real harm that the GOP’s healthcare cuts — including billions of cuts to Medicaid and Medicare — will have on people across New Hampshire.  

The fight to protect your healthcare continues, and I’m never giving up.

This week, I spent time with Granite Staters with @ALZIMPACT and heard about the heartbreak and challenges that thousands of patients, caregivers, and families across New Hampshire battling Alzheimer’s and dementia face every single day. 

It’s an honor to bring your voices to Congress in our fight to protect your healthcare and advance mission-critical research and clinical trials to help us end Alzheimer's as we know it.

The impacts of the GOP’s cuts to Medicaid are not hypothetical. They are real for real people right here in New Hampshire, including the patients who received care at the Franconia Health Center. 

We should be expanding access to lifesaving healthcare, not eliminating it. I will never stop fighting to ensure our rural communities have the care they need.

We have a sacred obligation to our servicemembers and our military families – that includes ensuring they have the same access to health care coverage as every other American.

I’m proud to introduce the Health Care Fairness for Military Families Act. This commonsense bill will save hundreds of thousands of American military families thousands of dollars every year.

I grew up right down the road from my great-grandparents' family farm in Nashua – I know how important New Hampshire’s farms are to the health of our communities and economy. 

Had a fantastic morning with local organic farmers from Weare, New Boston, Hillsborough, Nelson, Chichester, and Concord. We covered a lot of ground — from the critical role federal programs play in their work to the ways we can rein in the power of Big Ag in America. I’m proud to fight for New Hampshire’s incredible and resilient farmers in Congress and on the House Small Business Committee.

You and your family deserve access to high-quality, affordable healthcare, regardless of where you live. 

This morning in Lebanon, I met with the students who are the future of rural medicine — I left our conversations inspired by their determination and hopeful for the future we can build, together.

Life comes at you fast. And it’s not right that working people across New Hampshire are living one medical emergency away from bankruptcy, homelessness, or worse.

In Congress, I’m working to build an economy that works for hardworking people. That's why I am proud to help introduce commonsense legislation, guaranteeing paid family and medical leave.

While big healthcare corporations put profits over We the People, non-profit community health centers are working to deliver us the healthcare we need when and where we need it.  

That’s what I saw firsthand yesterday in Franklin during my visit to HealthFirst. And that’s why I’m working with every tool I’ve got in Congress to protect and strengthen New Hampshire’s community health centers.

We are living through the most brutal and relentless attack on New Hampshire’s community health centers in American history. Republican healthcare cuts are the biggest, most ruthless in history, and their impacts are not hypothetical. The pain and devastation are real for patients, providers, and places like @LampreyHealth in Nashua. 

Important conversation yesterday about how gutting healthcare is raising your already sky-high costs and forcing hardworking Americans to make impossible choices that no person should have to make. 

I will not give up in the fight for your healthcare.

Throughout my lifetime, Tess Kuenning has been a tireless champion for the health of the people of New Hampshire. And because of Tess, Bi-State is a lifeline for people across New Hampshire.

We are in the midst of the most brutal and relentless assault on New Hampshire’s community health centers in American history. In these dark and difficult days, I am grateful every day for Tess Kuenning.

Tess: thank you from the bottom of my heart for your 30 years at the helm. New Hampshire is healthier and stronger because of you, and I am proud and grateful to be working alongside you today and in the days ahead.

New Hampshire’s public schools are paying the price for our broken healthcare system and the GOP’s historic cuts to it. 

I’m working with every tool I’ve got to fix our broken system, protect your care, and lower your costs.
https://t.co/b5b7BxJCsh

I am fighting with everything I’ve got to protect and strengthen the healthcare our communities rely on and the people who we rely on to deliver that care. 

I spent the afternoon with the extraordinary team at Nashua Division of Public Health & Community Services. They meet Nashuans where they are wherever they are. From vaccines to housing to care in their mobile clinic, Nashua Public Health has got your back. Grateful for what they are doing for New Hampshire.

I’ve heard two words again and again to describe the impact of the GOP’s healthcare cuts on hardworking Granite Staters: “devastating” and “catastrophic.”

New Hampshire’s non-profit healthcare providers, including Dartmouth–Hitchcock Medical Center, are working around the clock to deliver the care people across our state need when they need it and where they need it. I will not give an inch when it comes to protecting and strengthening the healthcare New Hampshire families rely on.

Started off the day today hearing from community health providers from across New Hampshire who are on the frontlines delivering the care our communities need when they need it and where they need without breaking the bank.

Republican healthcare cuts – the biggest in history – are throwing our system into a full-blown crisis and jacking up your costs. Protecting and strengthening your healthcare means reversing these cuts, so that we can lower the sky-high costs that are crushing hardworking Americans.

"Cottage Hospital...like many small rural hospitals, faces staffing and financial pressures as costs continue to rise. Goodlander said she is concerned those pressures will worsen if the cuts...move forward."
https://t.co/vumy7GH7Dv

The mental health crisis and opioid epidemic have touched the lives of our kids in every community across New Hampshire and America. It’s going to take all of us working together to end this cycle and save lives. 

Yesterday in Plymouth, the amazing team at @CADY4Youth brought our community together around that vital mission, which I’m proud to help champion in Congress.

We’re in the fight of our lives to protect the healthcare you rely on. In the midst of this crisis, President Trump is slashing the healthcare millions of Americans need. 

This reckless move is about causing senseless pain for millions of Americans.
https://t.co/Rku8tznwzh

Healthcare costs are already sky-high, and the GOP’s Big, Brutal Budget is jacking up costs across the board. 

Important conversation in Concord this afternoon with patients and non-profit healthcare providers about what’s at stake. I am fighting with absolutely everything I got to lower your costs and protect your healthcare.
